name: Cyclopentyl methyl ether
about: Measured values each record of this component was fitted to (validation/python/measured_components.py). test/properties.test.js checks that the coefficients in src/data/components.json reproduce them within the maximum deviation stated in each record.

source.name: measured vapour pressures and the critical point
source.fit: 47 measured values (47 from the ThermoML Archive), 258.55-379.30 K, max deviation 3.4 %. No measured critical constants: the record covers the measured temperatures only. All the measured sets fitted together, each article with the same weight (no set preferred for a smaller stated uncertainty), pooled because they agree: each set lies within its mean stated uncertainty of the curve on average; mean deviation of the fit from each set: Mannisto 2018 +0.14 %; Mejia 2019 -0.15 %; Patel 2019 +2.68 %; Rehak 2017 +0.59 %.
